headline: 🔥 THE LISTING THAT COULD NOT GET A TOUR HAS NOW HAD THREE IN TWENTY-ONE HOURS — 225 Willow Point took a 9:00 AM and a 12:00 PM this morning from two different brokerages, and not one feedback form has come back on any of the three. ⭐ THE CLOCK ON THAT IS TODAY, NOT MONDAY: an agent who walked a house at noon remembers it at two, not on Monday morning — and nothing in the fleet has told you these two happened, because the milestone watcher already spent its one alert on yesterday's first tour. · DO: call both Willow Point agents — two tours held today · WATCH: Lake Crest's brokerage file EXPIRED this morning with proof of payment still required.

notes: 🚨 EIGHT ROUTINES STARTED THIS MORNING AND NOT ONE OF THEM LEFT A TRACE. The fleet's own health file shows only four names all day — the lead sweep, the delta, the market-report lane and the milestone watcher — while the scheduler says the marketing engine, the money app, the inbox triage, the database lane, the opportunity board, the folder sync and the 6:25 letter all fired on time. ⭐ THEY RAN AND WENT QUIET, which is a different failure from not running at all. ⚠️ It is the same shape as 8/20, and it means every health check reading that file today is reading a fraction of the truth.

🔴 THE 6:25 MORNING LETTER HAS NOW MISSED TWO CONSECUTIVE DAYS. It started on schedule both mornings and produced no letter either time — confirmed by searching your own inbox rather than by trusting a file, twice. ⭐ WHAT IS MISSING IS NOT ONE EMAIL: several routines stopped emailing you directly and now report only through that letter, so two days without it is two days of a compiled picture nobody assembled.

✅ THE WORKING HALF IS GENUINELY WORKING, AND IT SHOWED UP ON A SATURDAY. The lead sweep has run eight times since 6 AM with no gap, the milestone watcher caught all three of this morning's showing events inside the hour, and the market-report lane sent forty and verified all forty landed. ⚠️ It also deferred seven over its own daily cap and took three bounces — disclosed rather than buried, which is the behaviour you want.

callBlock.why: 🔴 THE ONLY ROW HERE WHERE THE PERSON WAITING IS ALREADY YOUR CLIENT. He texted at 10:39 this morning saying he has “a couple questions” — no subject, no urgency stated, which is exactly how a client opens a conversation he has been putting off. ⚠️ HIS CONDO IS ON DAY 155. ⭐ A client who has watched five months pass and still texts you first is not angry yet; that is a window, and it closes.

🆕 FRESHEST NAME ON THE WHOLE LIST AND IT LANDED TODAY. He came back to your site after thirty-plus days away, and the return visit — not the first one — is the signal that actually predicts a listing conversation. ⭐ CALL WHILE THE VISIT IS STILL TODAY'S NEWS. A same-day call on a re-engagement is the cheapest appointment on this board.

⚖️ THE COUNTER IS OUT AND THE BALL IS GENUINELY THEIRS. Your seller approved it at 9:01 this morning, you answered at 9:17, it was delivered at 10:00 and acknowledged one minute later — a clean hour of work with a receipt at every step. ⚠️ WHAT IS STILL MISSING IS THEIRS TO SEND: the written counter coming back and the preapproval, which is now roughly a day late. ⭐ The right move is a chase on the paperwork, not a re-negotiation.

callBlock.who: Amy G. of Ethos International — 355 Comanche
callBlock.why: 🔥 DAY SEVEN ON THE STRONGEST BUYER READ THIS LISTING HAS EVER PRODUCED. She filed it herself: interested — YES, her buyers have just started looking, they really like it, and it sits at the TOP of their list. She also phoned from inside the house mid-showing, so this is a returned call rather than a cold one. ⭐ SHE LEFT “PRICED RIGHT” BLANK — the obstacle here is unasked, not absent. 🔴 And the one physical complaint on this file is still unanswered: the basement lights would not come on. ⛔ Call rather than write; the co-op mail lane is a deliberate hold.

callBlock.who: Sanchez T. — a rule you owe the machine
callBlock.why: ⚖️ STILL UNRULED, NOW INTO ITS SECOND DAY, AND IT BLOCKS EVERY FUTURE CASE LIKE IT. He clicked your Willow Point ad and registered on your site four minutes later — a self-escalating buyer — and gave you his number himself, twice, on a record that carries a do-not-call flag on that same number. ⭐ AN UNATTENDED ROUTINE CORRECTLY REFUSED TO DECIDE THAT. One word from you settles it permanently, and until you say it the machine keeps holding buyers like him.

🔥 STILL THE CLEANEST BUYER ON THE BOARD AND NOW INTO A THIRD DAY UNCALLED. He texted back his own criteria unprompted at 11:44 at night — four bed, three and a half to four bath, a defined ceiling and a monthly payment he can carry. ⭐ A buyer who answers a machine text at midnight with specifics is not browsing. ⚠️ ONE THING TO TEST ON THE CALL: the price he named and the payment he named may not fit each other once taxes and insurance are in — a conversation, not a problem. 🔍 He answered the WHAT without answering the WHERE, and the area is the highest-value thing to get.

callBlock.who: Brett P., Joey B. and Richerd M. — Willow Point ad buyers
callBlock.why: 🔴 THREE PAID-AD BUYERS OFF THE ONE LISTING THAT IS ACTUALLY MOVING, AND NOBODY HAS SPOKEN TO ANY OF THEM. ⭐ TODAY IS THE ARGUMENT: that house just took two tours in one morning from two different brokerages. The ad is working, the house is showing, and the phone is the only broken link in the chain. ⚠️ One of the three hard-bounced, so the phone is the only lane that works on that record at all.

callBlock.who: Zach of McFarlane Homes — Deer Ridge Lakes
callBlock.why: 🏗️ A BUILDER WHO CAME OFF YOUR YARD SIGN AND ASKED WHETHER THE LOTS ARE STILL AVAILABLE — the highest-value inbound this land listing has ever produced, and the callback is now four days overdue. ⭐ A builder is not a buyer for one lot; he is a buyer for a phase. ⚠️ The perc-test records are still the number-one unanswered question on this file and he will ask for them — have the answer before you dial.

listings.note: 🆕 THE MOST IMPORTANT CARD ON THE BOARD THIS MORNING. Zero tours in its first three days, then three inside twenty-one hours: yesterday 4:30 PM, today 9:00 AM, today noon — the last two from two different brokerages. A fourth was booked for 4:00 this afternoon and cancelled ten minutes later. ⚠️ NOT ONE FEEDBACK FORM HAS COME BACK ON ANY OF THEM, and this address has never once sent a REQUESTED notice, only CONFIRMED — so the scheduler will not tell you how they went. ⭐ Call both of today's agents while the walk-throughs are hours old, then call the sellers with what you learn.

✅ THE PIECE THAT WAS OWED LAST NIGHT GOT DONE THIS MORNING, CLEANLY. Your seller approved the counter at 9:01, you answered at 9:17, it was delivered to the buyer's agent at 10:00 with the furniture carve-out and acknowledged at 10:01. ⚠️ THE OPEN ITEMS ARE NOW THEIRS: the written counter coming back and a preapproval that is roughly a day late. ⭐ The honest risk is unchanged — these buyers must close their own house first, so this is a contingency, not a closing.

listings.status: ⏰ CLOSED AT THE TABLE — now with negative proof
listings.note: 🔴 THE SILENCE BECAME A SIGNAL THIS MORNING. Two days past the table there is still no funding or recording receipt — and at 10:29 the brokerage's own system said the transaction has EXPIRED, commission document sent, proof of payment still REQUIRED. ⭐ That is no longer an absence of news; it is the system saying the last step never happened. One call to the closing attorney answers it, and it is the highest-leverage call in the book.

✅ THE DATE IS SETTLED AND THIS BOARD HAD IT RIGHT: the title firm put it in writing — Friday the 28th at 4 PM at their Moody office. The brokerage system still prints 8/31; the title firm is the one that matters. 🔴 THREE ITEMS ARE STILL OPEN AND NOBODY ANSWERED IN-THREAD: survey, home warranty, septic/sewer inspection. ⭐ SEPTIC HAS LEAD TIME — a problem found on the 27th does not close on the 28th. Six days left and two of them are a weekend.

The roof report and inspection addendum went out Thursday and were acknowledged the same afternoon — the deadline you set was met. ⚠️ The buyers' answer is the next thing owed and was expected into this weekend; the appraisal sits behind it. A second addendum and a roof quote landed Friday but did not move the deal forward.

⚠️ FOUR INDEPENDENT AGENT READS NOW SAY THE SAME THING, and the most recent added the worst staging score on this board — one out of five. ⭐ SHE ALSO NAMED A LEVER THAT IS NOT A PRICE CUT: a pre-inspection, because “unknowns” is exactly what one removes. One named live buyer sits under the ask and told you so in writing. An institutional seller is the most number-driven counterparty you will ever carry — this is the file that moves one.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — the one YES is day seven
listings.note: Four tours in nine days, and the pricing question is settled — five consecutive reads since the cut either called it just right or declined to argue it. 🔴 THE UNFIXED THING IS PHYSICAL AND CHEAP: the basement lights that would not come on, reported a week ago and still unanswered. ⭐ The strongest read this listing has ever drawn is still uncalled.

⚠️ THIRTEEN DAYS ON THE STRONGEST SINGLE WORD ANY AGENT HAS FILED ON THIS BOARD. Three reads in one weekend; two said not interested and one answered the interest question with “Very.” ⭐ The price cut is verified live and the objection from both passes is square footage, not the number — so another cut buys nothing here. She is still the cheapest uncalled name in the book.

All three gates are essentially behind it. ⚠️ Two quiet items, both paperwork rather than condition: the inspection requests have sat with your seller since 8/17, now five days — and the title firm still cannot find your seller's name in title, with a third name in play on the same file.

🔴 THE MOST EXPENSIVE LISTING IN THE BOOK AND NOT ONE TOUR HAS EVER BEEN BOOKED ON IT. ⭐ THIS MORNING SHARPENS THE POINT RATHER THAN SOFTENING IT: a $185K listing just drew three tours in a day off the same marketing machine that has never produced one here. The comp work says the big-house ceiling in that zip is roughly $950K unless acreage carries it — which makes the silence a pricing answer, not a marketing one.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — highest lead yield you own
listings.note: No lockbox tours, but more inbound than any house on this list. ⚠️ A builder off the yard sign is still owed a callback — four days now — and the perc-test records remain the number-one gap on the file.

⭐ TODAY IS THE ARGUMENT FOR PRE-BOOKING IT. Willow Point ran paid ads for three days before anyone toured it, then took three tours in twenty-one hours once the market found it. The gap that costs money is between “photos ready” and “booked,” and it is eight days wide on this one.

pipeline.paceProjection: ⚠️ 20 CLOSED YTD ANNUALISES TO ROUGHLY 35 AGAINST A GOAL OF 45 — unchanged all week, and it stays unchanged until a funding receipt turns Lake Crest into number 21. 🔴 THAT IS NO LONGER JUST WAITING: the brokerage file on that deal EXPIRED this morning with proof of payment still required, so the one closing worth roughly half of this month's expected dollars is now flagged by the brokerage's own system rather than merely quiet. ⭐ Behind it, 195 Lake View on 8/28 and 3350 Altamont on 9/14 are both inside the window; 1709 Fieldstone on 10/23 is not. 🎯 The gap is about 1.8 contracts a week and the calendar keeps shrinking.

money.note: 🔴 A NEW MONEY FLAG LANDED AT 10:29 THIS MORNING AND IT IS ABOUT A DEAL YOU ALREADY CLOSED. The brokerage's system marked the Lake Crest transaction EXPIRED — commission document sent, proof of payment still listed as REQUIRED — two days after everyone signed. ⭐ A commission does not pay itself out of a file the system has closed as expired; that is a call to the closing attorney and to brokerage support, not a wait. ⚙️ SEPARATE AND DATED: the brokerage share consolidation completes this weekend and the ticker changes Tuesday — the multiplier inside the money app must change with it or that page prints roughly ten times the true value. Flagged early so it never prints wrong. ⚠️ STILL OPEN FROM FRIDAY: a scheduled debt-settlement draft failed and the creditor left the door open to a smaller payment, which makes it a phone call rather than a payment — nothing since retired it. The accounting software still reads a balance the bank does not recognise; the session that unblocks it is Monday. ⚠️ Balances, amounts and account details are deliberately withheld — this page is public.

isa.decayPolicy: 🔴 EIGHTY-THREE OPEN ROWS, UP NINE SINCE FRIDAY LUNCH, AND EIGHTY OF THEM ARE DUE OR OVERDUE. ⭐ THE USEFUL DISTINCTION IS NOT AGE, IT IS DIRECTION: roughly a third are people actively waiting on YOU — a returned call, an answered question, a promise in your own words. Those cost relationships. The rest are prospects to chase, and they only cost opportunities. 🎉 THE STRONGEST ARGUMENT FOR WORKING THE LIST IS ON IT TWICE THIS WEEK: the listing you won came off a row overdue eighteen days, and this morning you sent that same man a value report and net sheet before nine. 🔥 The freshest rows are still sellers — several homeowners this week disputed your own valuation on their own houses UPWARD, which is the most reliable listing signal your site produces. 🔍 And roughly a third of the list is still contactless address-only records queued for re-pull; the build that would turn them into named, callable people has been the top queued build for two weeks.
isa.sweepCadence: every 30 minutes while the fleet is up — eight passes since 6 AM today with no gap, on a Saturday. ⭐ THE PATTERN WORTH SEEING KEEPS PROVING ITSELF AND IT ALWAYS TAKES TWO CHANNELS AT ONCE: this morning's counter authorisation was a text read beside an email thread, and Friday's offer discovery was a text that named no property read beside an email eight minutes older that did. 🎯 NEITHER EXISTED IN EITHER CHANNEL ALONE. ✅ THE OWNERSHIP GUARD IS HOLDING — it has now correctly left several leads untouched as a teammate's and is running perfect against an ad footer that keeps naming the wrong agent. ⚠️ The thing to watch is not this lane; it is the eight sibling routines that ran this morning and logged nothing at all.
